verdict.rationale: Isaac documents unattended execution of its own workloads: Isaac Lab training runs in standalone headless mode from workstation to data center and scales to clusters, and Isaac Sim is said to let developers "automate workflows" and run in Docker for repeatable setups. This is a vague, developer-scripted form of automation rather than a user-configurable background automation feature. Missing for 10: any documented way to set up automations (schedules, triggers, or persistent background jobs), agent-driven autonomous task execution beyond training runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
